scenes.title: A Coat of Many Colors
beats: Long ago, a man named Jacob had twelve sons. Joseph was one of the youngest, and his father loved him very much.
One day, Jacob gave Joseph a beautiful coat of many colors: red and orange, yellow and green, blue and purple!
But Joseph’s big brothers were jealous. “Why does he get a special coat?” they grumbled. They wouldn’t even say a kind word to him.

layers.prompt: Outside the family’s tents on green hills in warm afternoon light, with sheep grazing nearby: Joseph twirls happily in his colorful striped coat, right of center, while his old father Jacob watches with a proud smile; further back, his ten big brothers stand together with their arms folded, frowning and grumbling

scenes.title: Joseph’s Dreams
beats: One night Joseph had a dream. The sun, the moon and eleven stars all bowed down to him!
“Listen to my dream!” Joseph told his family. His brothers got even angrier. “Do you think you’ll be the boss of us?”

layers.prompt: At night under a deep blue sky: Joseph lies fast asleep on a woven mat outside the family tent, right of center, wrapped in his colorful striped coat, and above him in a soft, glowing dream-cloud in the sky, a smiling golden sun, a silver crescent moon and eleven bright stars all bow down toward him

scenes.title: Far Away to Egypt
beats: One day, the brothers saw Joseph coming in his coat. They took the coat away and put Joseph down into an empty well.
Then some traders came by with their camels, on their way to Egypt. The brothers sold Joseph to them, and the traders took him far, far away.
Joseph was all alone. But he wasn’t really alone at all. God was with him.

layers.prompt: In dry, golden desert hills under a wide sky: a long caravan of traders with camels carrying bundles heads toward the far horizon, and young Joseph, without his colorful coat and wearing only a plain cream tunic, walks sadly among them, right of center, looking back over his shoulder; far behind on a hill, his ten brothers stand beside an old stone well, holding the colorful coat; gentle and calm, not frightening

scenes.title: God Was With Joseph
beats: In Egypt, hard things kept happening to Joseph. He was even put in prison when he hadn’t done anything wrong. But God was with him the whole time.
One night, Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, dreamed about seven fat cows and seven skinny cows. Nobody knew what it meant, except Joseph! God showed him.
“Seven years of plenty are coming, then seven hungry years,” Joseph said. So Pharaoh put Joseph in charge of all Egypt, to save up food for everyone!

layers.prompt: In sunny Egypt beside the river Nile, with palm trees and pyramids far in the distance: Joseph, now a grown young man with a short beard, dressed as a ruler of Egypt in a white linen robe, a broad gold collar and a gold chain, stands proudly on the steps right of center beside Pharaoh in his striped royal headdress, both pointing at enormous storehouses overflowing with golden grain, while workers carry baskets of wheat

scenes.title: “I Am Joseph!”
beats: Then the hungry years came. Joseph’s brothers had no food, so they came all the way to Egypt to buy some. They bowed down low to the ruler, just like in Joseph’s dream. They didn’t know it was him!
Joseph couldn’t keep it in any longer. He cried and cried. “I am Joseph, your brother!” His brothers were so scared!
But Joseph hugged every one of them. “Don’t be afraid,” he said. “You meant to hurt me, but God meant it for good.” And the whole family was together again.

layers.prompt: In a grand Egyptian palace hall with painted columns and warm light: Joseph, a grown young man with a short beard dressed as a ruler of Egypt in a white linen robe and a broad gold collar, stands right of center looking down with tears in his eyes, while his ten brothers in plain shepherd robes kneel and bow low in a row before him, their faces to the floor

layers.edit: Joseph has come down to his brothers and is hugging them with happy tears, his arms around two of them, while the other brothers have stood up and gather around, amazed and joyful, some wiping their eyes and smiling; the hall glows with warm golden light.

questions: How do you think Joseph felt when his brothers were mean to him?
Joseph forgave his brothers. Why is it hard to forgive sometimes?
Even when bad things happened, God was with Joseph. When do you need to remember that God is with you?

verse.text: What you intended against me for evil, God intended for good.
